title: ContentType
description: A content type (proposal 0006, Part B): the contract between the sources that produce one kind of item and the modes that read it. A folder content-types/<name>/ holds content-type.yaml (this file's shape), fields.schema.json (the fields the kind adds to item/v1) and views.sql (only CREATE VIEW v_<name> statements over the base tables). The store builds the views of the types it holds; agents query them.

version.description: The `<kind>/v<N>` that connectors `produces:` and modes `reads:`. A store records it; a store of another version is refused.

kind.description: The item `kind` value of the items this type describes.

views.description: What `describe` tells agents about each view views.sql creates, keyed by view name (v_<name>). The documented columns must equal the real ones.

item.description: One row per item: describe adds samples and a time span.

includes.description: The view starts with every column of this base view; `note` is what describe says about those columns.
